units.source_text: Once my body softens a little, I don't have to use that opening to go looking for pain.

I can bring to mind a pet, a baby, a friend, a partner, or anyone I naturally love. I feel the real love that's already there and see if some of it can move from my heart toward the younger part around the solar plexus, then back up again.
units.output_text: You may find that once you have softened a little you may not need to use the above method to begin with, you might just think of something you love, a pet, a baby, a friend, your partner etc., and feel the love that is there and try to send it from your heart to your younger self at your solar plexus and back again.
